steps.text: Find the four lost Glowcap spores in the Undergardens, the caves under the Secret Gardens. Pip's glow will light the way.
checklist: One in the Root Hall, high in the roots
One on the island in the Crystal Pool

steps.text: Take the spores to the Old Taproot, at the very bottom of the Undergardens.

reward.message: The Old Taproot gave you Glowcap seeds: they glow in your garden at night! (+15 sparkles)
